spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.name: The Grue
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.whisper.1: Such a little light. It will not last.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.whisper.2: They fought me once. Look where they are now. Look where I am.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.whisper.3: Keep reaching for the dark. I am right here, at the bottom of it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.taken.1: At last. A body that walks in the sun.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.taken.2: Hush now. Eat when you are hungry. I will see to everything else.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.taken.3: Your old friend is gone. I am your friend now.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.taunt.1: Your friends have not noticed. Isn't that sad?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.taunt.2: I am getting very good at being you.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.taunt.3: Your hands are warm. I had forgotten warm.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.free.2: They always come for me. Always the ones you love.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.free.3: I will find another door. There is always another door.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.trial.1: Come, little light. Let us see what you are made of. Inside.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.trial.2: No one will hear you up here. No one ever did.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.trial.3: You opened the door. Now come through it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.beaten.1: Again... beaten by a child and a dead man.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.beaten.2: Fine. Hold the leash, then. See how long your hands stay clean.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.beaten.3: I am yours, then. For now. Use me well.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.finale.1: Enough tricks. Hands, then. Yours against mine.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grue.finale.2: Your spirit taught you to punch? I taught it to bleed.
